title: EndoNeRF
paper_title: EndoNeRF: Neural Radiance Fields for Endoscopic View Synthesis
core_mech: EndoNeRF 以时间条件 deformation MLP 把动态组织映射到 canonical NeRF，并显式利用手术器械 mask。
core_mech_en: Reconstructs deformable soft-tissue scenes from single-viewpoint stereo robotic endoscopy by pairing a canonical static NeRF with a time-conditioned deformation field and tool occlusion masks.
input_desc: 双目/视频内镜帧、相机位姿、时间戳及手术器械二值 mask
input_en: Robotic stereo endoscopy video frames, estimated stereo depth maps, timestamps t, and binary surgical tool masks
output_desc: 动态软组织的 canonical 几何、深度和新视角内镜图像
output_en: Tool-free dynamic 3D soft-tissue surface geometry, depth maps, and novel-view renderings
